classes.label: Airport
classes.comment: A facility where regularly-scheduled aircraft arrive and depart.

classes.label: Meteorological condition
classes.comment: A representation of the meteorological status for the specified time period, including sky, wind, visibility, and weather subcomponents.

classes.label: Weather condition
classes.comment: The current or forecast weather conditions at a given airport or other reporting station.

object_properties.label: forecasting airport
object_properties.comment: Links to the airport for which the report was compiled.

object_properties.label: has Meteorological report
object_properties.comment: Associates an airport with weather reports generated for that airport.

datatype_properties.label: data interval end time
datatype_properties.comment: For temporally-dependent data, the ending time of the data's period of validity.

datatype_properties.label: data interval start time
datatype_properties.comment: For temporally-dependent data, the starting time of the data's period of validity.

datatype_properties.label: forecast issue time
datatype_properties.comment: The time that the report was issued.

datatype_properties.label: meteorological condition status
datatype_properties.comment: An indicator of whether the meteorological condition is based on actual observations (observed) or on future projections (forecast).

datatype_properties.label: taf report string
datatype_properties.comment: The full text of the entire Meteorological report.
